rv.q: In this evocative portrait of Frida Kahlo, art becomes more than a reflection of life; it gives lasting form to the love, longing, and memories that continue to inhabit us.
Another highlight of an outstanding performance is how she conveys Frida as a woman accustomed to pain who is, at the end of her life, suddenly pushed into agony even she thought impossible.
Both playwright and performer, Vanessa Severo (Frida Kahlo) is simply astonishing in this production.
If you are a connoisseur of great acting, then by all means see this play.
